# Cloudflare D1

A D1 binding (SQLite on Cloudflare) and the `@repo/db` package.

Id `database/d1`: Cloudflare D1, in the Database slot. Template: [`templates/database/d1/`](../../templates/database/d1/).

## What it is for

SQLite on Cloudflare D1, reached through the `DB` binding. `pnpm db:migrate` applies the migrations to the local D1 database that wrangler keeps for development. The ORM add-on fills the `@repo/db` package it creates.

## Add it

When you create the project:

```sh
npm create efforge my-app -- --database=d1
```

Add it to an existing project whose `database` is `none` (a single-choice slot only moves from `none` to a value):

```sh
npx create-efforge add database/d1
```

## Needs

- An ORM, added in the same command: `npx create-efforge add database/d1 orm/drizzle` or `orm/effect-sql`.
- The Cloudflare runtime, which every project has today.

## Conflicts with

Nothing.

## Service and layer

None: this add-on adds no service of its own.

| `packages/db/tsconfig.json` | Always |

## Files it edits

`efforge add` makes these edits with AST transforms, so it changes only what is listed and leaves the rest of each file alone.

### `wrangler.jsonc`

- Adds a `d1_databases` entry: `{"binding": "DB", "database_name": "app", "database_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", "migrations_dir": "packages/db/migrations"}`. Only with `infra=none`.

### `infra/alchemy.run.ts`

- Declares `database` and binds it to the Worker as `DB`. Only with `orm=drizzle` and `infra=alchemy`.
- Declares `database` and binds it to the Worker as `DB`. Only with `orm=effect-sql` and `infra=alchemy`.

### `AGENTS.md`

- Adds the rules under [Rules it adds to AGENTS.md](#rules-it-adds-to-agentsmd).

### `apps/web/package.json`

- Adds the dependencies listed below.

### `packages/db/package.json`

- Adds the dependencies listed below.

### `packages/core/package.json`

- Adds the dependencies listed below.

### `pnpm-workspace.yaml`

- Pins the new dependencies in the `catalog`.

### `package.json`

- Sets the scripts `db:migrate`; a script of the same name is replaced.

### `efforge.jsonc`

- Records the add-on in the stack and the hashes of the files it wrote.

## Package scripts

## Rules it adds to AGENTS.md

Only with `orm=drizzle`:

### Database (D1, Drizzle)

- Tables live in `packages/db/src/schema.ts`; queries go through the `Database` service from `@repo/core`.
- Change the schema, then run `pnpm --filter @repo/db db:generate` to write a migration to `packages/db/drizzle/`, then `pnpm db:migrate` (flattens them into `packages/db/migrations/` and applies them locally).
- Never edit files under `packages/db/drizzle/` or `packages/db/migrations/` by hand; they are generated.

Only with `orm=effect-sql`:

### Database (D1, effect-sql)

- Migrations are plain SQL files in `packages/db/migrations/`, named `NNNN_name.sql` and applied in order by `pnpm db:migrate` (wrangler, local D1).
- Add a new file for every schema change; never edit one that has already been applied.
- Queries go through the `Database` service from `@repo/core`.

## Limits

- With `infra=alchemy`, `pnpm db:migrate` still expects a `wrangler.jsonc`.
